class.name: NextGeoDebug
class.brief_description: Offline NextGeo DAG inspection and cluster-export helpers for PQ spike measurements.
class.description: Provides static helpers that run the NextGeo offline cluster DAG builder and finest-level meshlet clusterizer in memory on a [Mesh] without writing [code].ngm[/code] files. Used by multi-material root-cut/depth measurements and draw-identity benchmarks.

method.name: build_stats
method.description: Runs the NextGeo cluster DAG builder in memory on all triangle surfaces of [param mesh] and returns a [Dictionary] containing [code]source_triangles[/code], [code]root_cut_triangles[/code], [code]dag_depth[/code], [code]cluster_count[/code], [code]group_count[/code], [code]terminal_groups[/code], [code]locked_vertex_fraction[/code], [code]build_ms[/code], and [code]surface_count[/code].

method.name: export_clusters
method.description: Clusterizes all triangle surfaces of [param mesh] at the finest level (at most 128 triangles and 128 vertices per cluster) using meshoptimizer and packs the header, cluster bounding/cone descriptors, vertex positions, and triangle indices into a tightly packed little-endian byte buffer.
